mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: A second step after your password, from an app on your phone. An admin can approve stalls, deactivate customers and change what the platform charges, so a password on its own is thin.

step1.title: Scan this with your authenticator
step1.text: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password — any of them. Nothing is sent anywhere: the code below is drawn by your own browser.
step1.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
step1.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key in by hand:

step2.title: Type the code it shows
step2.text: This proves the phone and the server agree on the time before anything is switched on.

step3.title: Save your recovery codes
step3.text: Ten codes, each usable once. They are the only way back in if you lose the phone — and this platform has one admin account, so losing it locks everybody out.
step3.pending: The codes appear here once the code above is confirmed.

regen.title: Make new recovery codes?
regen.text: The ten you have now stop working straight away. Save the new ones before you close this screen.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification?
disable.text: Your password becomes the only thing standing between anyone and the approvals, the customer accounts and the platform prices.

codes.copied: Copied. Keep them somewhere other than the phone that holds the authenticator.
codes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes and copy them by hand.
